t: Above you is Admiralty Arch, the Grade I listed landmark that links The Mall with Trafalgar Square. King Edward VII commissioned it in memory of his mother, Queen Victoria, and Aston Webb designed it. Webb also designed the principal facade of Buckingham Palace and the main building of the Victoria and Albert Museum. Until 2011 the arch housed government offices, including the residence of the First Sea Lord. In 2012 it was sold on a 125-year lease, and it is being turned into a luxury hotel, the Waldorf Astoria, scheduled to open in 2026.
